title: DVB-T2 preset and graph-API example for gf2-sim
description:
## Goal

Express the full DVB-T2 BICM chain via both the typestate-builder
preset (from Phase A `81d05bab`) and a worked-example graph API
chain (from Phase A `c09d3e95`), demonstrating that the two API
layers produce byte-identical output for the same input.

## Context

Task under story `5d0a3fad` (DVB-T2 BICM application) within epic
`gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Phase 0 design doc:
`dev/active/ec530af9-pipeline-design.md` §9 (both API forms),
§12 (migration plan). Wave D.1: depends on Story C (`9e853c62`).

This task is the integration smoke for Phase A and Phase B working
together as a DVB-T2 application. It exercises the typestate
builder, the graph API, the channels, the GPU stages (when
`--features hip` is set), and the hybrid executor — end-to-end on
one canonical chain.

## Deliverables

1. `crates/gf2-sim/src/presets/dvb_t2.rs` enrichment:
   - The preset's internal graph construction (the `build()` impl
     established by `81d05bab`) is wired to the canonical DVB-T2
     BICM chain with all production stages (BCH + LDPC +
     interleaver + Gray-QAM + AWGN + soft demap + inverse +
     LDPC dec + BCH dec).
   - `Pipeline::dvb_t2()...build()` produces a working pipeline
     that runs to completion on a 200-frame batch at any (rate,
     modulation) ∈ the 6 in-scope MODCODs.
2. `crates/gf2-sim/examples/dvb_t2_typestate.rs`:
   - 30–50 line example showing the typestate builder for r1/2
     16-QAM. Runs end-to-end; prints summary table.
3. `crates/gf2-sim/examples/dvb_t2_graph_api.rs`:
   - Side-by-side hand-wired chain via `Chain::new()...build()`.
   - Comment in the file points at the typestate example for
     comparison.
4. `crates/gf2-sim/tests/preset_vs_graph_byte_identity.rs`:
   - For each of the 6 in-scope MODCODs:
     - Build pipeline via typestate preset.
     - Build same pipeline via graph API.
     - Run 200 frames at a fixed seed, fixed Es/N0.
     - Assert byte-identity of `fer / frames / errors / mean_iters`
       between the two forms.
     - BER excluded per status quo.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] DVB-T2 BICM chain runs end-to-end via both API forms for
  all 6 in-scope MODCODs.
- [hard] Byte-identity of the four deterministic columns between
  typestate and graph forms at fixed seed across all 6 MODCODs.
- [hard] Both `examples/` compile and run via
  `cargo run -p gf2-sim --example <name> --release`.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review` gates green.

## Non-goals

- GPU-vs-CPU byte-identity (owned by Phase B `14f59c2d` for the
  cross-cutting view; Phase D `0d9cb8e3` for the full DVB-T2
  regression).
- 5G NR preset (owned by Phase E `e478daa8`).
